title: UAAP: UP women off to fine start with sweep of UST in badminton

blocks.text: Pat De Leon marked a successful return to the UAAP by helping the University of the Philippines sweep University of Santo Tomas, 5-0, on the opening day of the team event of the Season 89 women's badminton tournament on Saturday at the Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
